item.title: Loop Behind: Rethinking Where Extra Loops Pay Off in Looped Language Models
item.description: Looped language models improve performance by repeatedly applying shared layers, with gains commonly attributed to giving the current token extra computation. Disentangling per-token loop count from Loop KV depth on Dory-4B reveals that one loop reading loop-2 KV recovers 6.8 of 7.2 points, unlocking training-free parallel Loop-Behind Decoding.
